name: publishes
definition: An organization or vendor officially releases or issues a security advisory, bulletin, or patch.

name: addresses-vulnerability-in
definition: A security advisory or patch provides fixes for security vulnerabilities affecting a software product.

name: affects
definition: A security vulnerability compromises or impacts a specific software product or component.

name: located-in
definition: An organization, entity, or infrastructure is geographically or administratively based in a country or location.

name: part-of
definition: An entity or component is a constituent sub-part of a larger system, suite, or organization.

name: hosts
definition: An IP address, server, or domain hosts a specific file, malware payload, or service.

name: delivers
definition: An exploit, campaign, or delivery mechanism drops or downloads a payload onto a target system.

name: exploits
definition: A threat actor, malware, or campaign leverages a specific security vulnerability to compromise systems.

name: attacks
definition: A threat actor compromises, targets, or executes unauthorized actions against a system, service, or organization.

name: communicates-with
definition: A malware payload or host establishes network connections to an external IP address or server.

name: uses-malware
definition: A threat actor utilizes or deploys a specific malware tool or family in their operations.

name: attributed-to
definition: A threat cluster, campaign, or activity is attributed to or associated with another threat group.
